title: Wren and the Drop
author: Vesper Zhou
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
